tasks.subject: B8.1: create_app(settings) factory, real lifespan test, ensure_dirs before mount
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A lifespan factory that constructs its own UiSettings (imported from scoutmb.config), JobSupervisor, and FastAPI app fresh per call -- nothing at module import time touches the filesystem, network, or starts a task. ensure_dirs() runs synchronously in create_app (not only in the lifespan) so a later StaticFiles mount doesn't crash on a directory that doesn't exist yet.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/scoutmb/interfaces/web/app.py`
- Test: `tests/integration/test_app_lifespan.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Importing scoutmb.interfaces.web.app performs no filesystem/network I/O and starts no task
- [ ] create_app(settings) returns a distinct FastAPI instance on every call
- [ ] app.state.job_registry is a JobSupervisor; lifespan shutdown calls job_registry.shutdown()
- [ ] GET /api/health returns {"status": "ok"} -- lifespan driven via app.router.lifespan_context(app), not bare ASGITransport
- [ ] settings.ensure_dirs() called synchronously in create_app, before any later StaticFiles mount could fail

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/integration/test_app_lifespan.py -q` → PASS

POST-CODEX FIX: UiSettings now imported from scoutmb.config (sub-plan 2), not a new scoutmb.ui_settings module. Lifespan test now uses app.router.lifespan_context(app) -- bare ASGITransport does not run lifespan at all. ensure_dirs() moved to run synchronously in create_app to fix a StaticFiles-mount-before-directory-exists ordering bug. See plan doc Task B8.1.

tasks.subject: B8.2: Fix UI-ROUTE-023/030 directly on ui/server.py (NOT UI-ROUTE-021)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Land UI-ROUTE-023 (cross-platform folder open via a mockable, thread-wrapped open_folder function) and UI-ROUTE-030 (validate html_report before use, preserving the existing webbrowser.open call for valid input) on the live module, plus the PDF-upload unlink guard and open_report's summary.json guard. generate_emails's scouts.json read is DELIBERATELY left unguarded -- UI-ROUTE-021 is a PRESERVE case pinning today's 500 crash, not a bug to fix.

**Files:**
- Modify: `ui/server.py` (start_pdf_extract, open_report, open_emails_folder)
- Modify: `tests/matrix/cases/interface_cases.py`, `tests/characterization/test_interface_matrix.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] start_pdf_extract's cleanup only unlinks files (is_file() guard)
- [ ] open_emails_folder dispatches on sys.platform through a named, mockable open_folder function, called via asyncio.to_thread (never blocking the route's event loop)
- [ ] open_report rejects any html_report not a bare filename resolving inside RUNS_DIR/<run_id>, BEFORE constructing a URL or calling webbrowser.open
- [ ] open_report's webbrowser.open call is PRESERVED for valid html_report (UI-ROUTE-018 must stay green)
- [ ] open_report's summary.json read is guarded (400 not 500) -- generate_emails's scouts.json read is NOT touched (UI-ROUTE-021 must stay green, unmodified)
- [ ] UI-ROUTE-023/030 expected_by_context updated; digest bumped via `uv run python tools/check_case_digest.py --update` in the same commit

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/characterization/test_interface_matrix.py tests/matrix -q` → PASS

CRITICAL POST-CODEX FIX: an earlier draft of this task guarded generate_emails's scouts.json read, which silently broke UI-ROUTE-021 (a PRESERVE case) -- an undeclared 7th intentional-change row beyond the spec's six sanctioned exceptions. That guard is REMOVED. Also fixed: open_folder now wrapped in asyncio.to_thread (was a blocking call in an async route); digest command corrected. See plan doc Task B8.2's Design Note.

tasks.subject: B8.3: Package route surface + parity test (real lifespan)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** src/scoutmb/interfaces/web/routes.py + composition.py cover the same route surface as the now-fixed ui/server.py, wired through JobSupervisor, proven equivalent by a parity test that actually runs the app's lifespan.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/scoutmb/interfaces/web/routes.py`, `src/scoutmb/interfaces/web/composition.py`
- Modify: `src/scoutmb/interfaces/web/app.py`
- Test: `tests/parity/test_local_web_parity.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Every route ui/server.py exposes has a package-side equivalent with matching status codes and response bodies
- [ ] Package's pdf-extract/schedule-download routes track state via app.state.job_registry
- [ ] _client_for() wraps app.router.lifespan_context(app), not bare ASGITransport -- every route touching request.app.state must actually have that state populated
- [ ] interfaces/web/routes.py imports features/ports/core only; composition.py is the only adapter-importing module in interfaces/web

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/parity/test_local_web_parity.py tests/characterization/test_interface_matrix.py tests/architecture -q` → PASS

POST-CODEX FIX: _client_for() previously used bare httpx.ASGITransport, which does not run FastAPI's lifespan -- every route would have raised AttributeError on request.app.state before any assertion ran. Fixed via app.router.lifespan_context(app). UiSettings now imported from scoutmb.config. See plan doc Task B8.3 -- route coverage must still be EXTENDED beyond the starter slice shown to cover the full route surface, per the task's own note.

tasks.subject: B9.1: run_app.py port-zero rendezvous fix (server actually accepts) + troop349 entrypoint
tasks.description:

- [ ] 50 rapid rebinds never collide
- [ ] A real server started via asyncio.start_server(sock=...) on the bound socket actually accepts a client connection -- not merely proven bindable
- [ ] troop349 launches the package app (imports UiSettings from scoutmb.config) in a pywebview window

tasks.subject: B9.2: troop349-schedule entrypoint + honest entrypoint parity coverage
tasks.description:
**Goal:** troop349-schedule wraps async_main/ScheduleConfig exactly as troop349-pdf already wraps stage 1, and entrypoint parity tests prove --help/missing-argument/handled-exception parity as subprocesses, plus a real KeyboardInterrupt->130 unit test for both main()s -- narrowed to only claim what is actually tested.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/scoutmb/interfaces/cli/schedule.py`
- Modify: `pyproject.toml`
- Test: `tests/parity/test_entrypoint_parity.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] --help matches flat script (subprocess, stdout compared)
- [ ] Missing --input exits 2 with matching stderr (subprocess)
- [ ] A handled exception (nonexistent --input FILE) exits 2 with matching "ERROR: " stderr prefix (subprocess) -- a genuinely different code path from the missing-argument case
- [ ] KeyboardInterrupt -> 130 proven by a UNIT test against each main() (monkeypatching asyncio.run), explicitly NOT a subprocess test -- reliably delivering real SIGINT would require the process blocked on a live Playwright launch, out of scope here
- [ ] troop349/troop349-pdf/troop349-schedule all pass the applicable subset -- no claim of untested "success" subprocess coverage (that's proven elsewhere by acquisition parity + characterization)

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/parity/test_entrypoint_parity.py -q` → PASS

POST-CODEX FIX: the original acceptance criteria claimed success/interrupt/handled-error/stderr coverage the actual tests never exercised. Added real handled-exception and KeyboardInterrupt tests; narrowed claims to match what's actually tested. See plan doc Task B9.2.
